name: Noir Ledger • Board kit
description: Atelier premium — carbon paper, ledger rules, stamped numerals for finance and board decks.

slides.title: Noir Ledger.
items: Carbon rules and stamped figures for rooms that decide with ink, not slides.

slides.title: Open the book.
items: A board deck should feel like a ledger already in use — ruled, stamped, and weighted. No empty cards pretending to be seriousness.
Ledgers hold the argument in columns the eye can audit.
One number carries the room — quiet proof around it.
One line of judgment. Then file.

slides.title: Four entries
items: State the position before the chart arrives.
Rule the page so every claim can be audited.
One figure. One source. No decoration.
Close with a decision, not a summary slide.

slides.title: Three inks
items: A faint second plate so the page never feels alone.
Reserved for the figure that must hold the room.
Thin horizontal law across every working page.

slides.title: One figure. One room.
items: If every number shouts, none of them decide.

slides.title: Night audit.
items: After hours on the floor — the only light left is the desk lamp and the last open ledger.

slides.title: File the ledger.
items: Stamp the figure. Close the book. Keep the carbon with the packet.
